mentions.name: techblo.gs
mentions.description: A tiny tech blog aggregator that collects and surfaces technology blog posts, created to highlight a wider variety of blogs than the ones that repeatedly appear on HN's front page. Built with Go as a learning exercise, and open to blog suggestions from readers.
mentions.problem: The same blogs appeared over and over on HN's front page, limiting discovery of other tech blogs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Created a tiny tech blog aggregator, after noticing the same blogs appeared over and over on HN’s front page: https://techblo.gs

evidence.value: Created a tiny tech blog aggregator, after noticing the same blogs appeared over and over on HN’s front page: https://techblo.gs
